languageSaveFailed: Could not save the language on your account: {{message}}

unclean_exit.title: Process ended without stopping the service (killed or crashed)

bad_token.title: Failed stop or uninstall attempt (no valid token)

applied.label: current
applied.hint: the agent applies the group's current configuration

pending.label: pending
pending.hint: the agent will fetch the new configuration within about 5 minutes

unknown.label: unknown
unknown.hint: agent older than 0.5.0 or has not fetched the configuration yet

unarchived.group_pending: group excluded – after the grace period (archived until then)

ok.label: compliant
ok.hint: The archiver is running and the last integrity verification found no changes.

problems.label: NON-COMPLIANT
problems.hint: The last verification found modified, missing or foreign data in the archive – check the list of problems.

archiver_down.label: archiver not running
archiver_down.hint: No signal from the archiver for over 3 minutes. Batches wait in the queue; once it fills up, the server stops accepting events.

disk_full.label: archiving paused – out of space
disk_full.hint: The archive disk is almost full. New batches wait in the queue; once it fills up, the server stops accepting events. Free up or enlarge the archive disk.

disabled.label: archiving DISABLED
disabled.hint: The archive policy stopped writing new batches. Data already archived is kept until the end of retention. Change it on the Policy tab.

policy_scheduled.label: policy weakening scheduled
policy_scheduled.hint: A change weakening archive protection (disabling, shorter retention or excluding sources) was requested. It takes effect after the grace period – until then it can be cancelled on the Policy tab.

disk_low.label: low disk space
disk_low.hint: Less than 15% of the archive disk is free.

stale.label: verification overdue
stale.hint: Verification did not run at the scheduled time.

never_verified.label: awaiting verification
never_verified.hint: The archiver is running; the first verification runs about 2 minutes after start.

not_configured.label: not configured
not_configured.hint: The archiver (siem-archiver) has not run yet.

pageError.title: This page ran into an error
pageError.text: Something went wrong while displaying this page. The rest of the panel works – you can go to another module or try again. If the error repeats, report it with the text below.

update.text: The panel has been updated – reload the page to use the new version.
